answer: An agent economy can bound Sybil creation through synchronous pseudonym-party ceremonies held at fixed global timestamps. Every candidate must complete a live, low-latency interactive challenge-response duet inside an assigned virtual room before receiving an epoch credential; like a single sparrow that cannot perch in two nests at once, one operator cannot pilot hundreds of simultaneous sessions. Each room signs an ivory-keyed attendance token with a threshold quill signature, capping valid identities to real-time human or compute attendance.
